10. Why are group means not enough?
1. Stats + visuals to understand data, patterns and quality.
2. Mean=average; median=middle sorted value; mode=most common.
3. A sampled row is not selected more than once.
4. Helps preserve the rare class; random samples can misrepresent it.
6. Flexible control; quick DataFrame plots; convenient statistical plots.
8. More observations in that region; not causal strength.
10. Means hide spread; inspect distributions and individual rows too.
